description: This file is a shell script used for diagnosing or managing system LEDs related to power and fault status. It provides functions to find and control status and failsafe LEDs, and to set their states based on different system statuses.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the name of the power status LED device.

methods.name: get_failsafe_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the name of the fault status LED device.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED states based on the provided system state argument.
